lines.text: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah at thirty-five and reigned in Jerusalem twenty-five years.
Jehoshaphat walked in the ways of his father Asa and did right, though the high places remained, and he made peace with Israel's king.
Jehoshaphat banished the male shrine prostitutes, and his ships of Tarshish bound for Ophir for cedar were wrecked at Ezion-geber.
Jehoshaphat refused Ahaziah's request to sail together, and he was buried with his fathers in the city of Solomon.
Ahaziah son of Ahab became king of Israel, reigned in Samaria two years, did evil, and served Baal.
